request: Build a small Jac web app for single-elimination tournaments. From a seeded list of participants it builds the bracket, padding with byes for the top seeds when the count is not a power of two. Reporting a match result moves the winner to the next round; the champion is known once the final is reported.
acceptance: With 6 participants the bracket has 8 slots and seeds 1 and 2 get first-round byes that advance them automatically.
Seeds 1 and 2 are placed in opposite halves, so they can only meet in the final.
Reporting a match whose two participants are not both known yet is rejected, and so is changing a result after the next-round match was played.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
